answer: Proposal 'bondslash': jury weight requires an escrowed bond per identity, and the ledger slashes the bond on one valid fraud proof, paying the prover a bounty. Equivocation is carved in marble: two conflicting signed votes are irrefutable. Rewards vest only after a challenge voyage of several epochs, so proven fraud is never paid. A swarm locks one bond per alias and donates each provably cheating bond to its catcher; cost stays linear, so the defense holds while locked capital is dear. Weight is a ramp, not a mesa — whales still buy influence, and unprovable bias escapes slashing.
